title: Photo & Video Locker - Gallery
summary: Lock photos, lock videos, lock documents with Photo and Video locker.
description:
Keep your secret photos, private videos and precious documents secure and private with photo & video locker. Photo and video Locker is your personal gallery vault where you can keep your most memorable videos and photos. This gallery locker is the easiest and safest way to create a secure location on your device to store and protect your private photos, private videos and important documents. Photo locker protects your app with a secret PIN and secret pattern.

This photo locker and video hider not only moves your photos / videos to a secret location on your phone but also hide photos and hide videos from any other apps. So, if anyone tries to find your hidden photos, they will be unable to find them because all photos and videos are saved in a secret place.

Video locker / photo vault is your secret gallery where you can keep your most memorable photos and videos and ensure that friends who use your phone don’t see your personal photos, private videos if they browse through your gallery.

Documents locker helps you to hide your most important and personal documents such as bank documents, company documents, Presentations and bills.

Keep safe all your private data in one place.

Features:
- Password protected app access with a PIN / Pattern / Finger print.
- Lock photos, lock videos and lock documents directly from your default gallery.
- Works with your device’s memory / SD card to import and export photos and videos.
- Break-in-alert: Takes photos of intruders and tracks break-in attempts
- For added privacy, you can choose an alternate App icon (like Calculator or Notes). Your content stays secure, and the change is fully optional.
- Fingerprint unlock.
- Create unlimited folders
- Built-in Video player
- Trash folder to keep your deleted files
- Album View to manage your photos/videos faster.
- No storage limitations with unlimited photos and videos.
- Automatically quits in device's sleep mode.
- Intuitive interface for a great experience.
- Share locked photos, locked videos directly on Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Etc.

- Slideshow photos
- Set cover image to your albums
- Set theme to depends on your mood

PASSWORD RECOVERY:
In case if you forget your passwords we will send you to your registered e-mail id.


FAQ:
Q: Where do my photos/videos go after I unlock them? 
A: Your videos will be at "sdcard/GalleryLocker_UnLocked_Pic" after unlocking.

Q: How can I change my password?
A: Tap the 'Settings' icon which will show you an option to change your PIN / Pattern.

Q: Are my hidden photos/videos stored online?
A: No. Your files are stored only on your device. We are not backup your files in any server.
